defects.description: Monthly advancement uses the clamped current date instead of the original billing day, permanently shifting renewals after a short month.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {RenewalCalendar} from "./src/calendar.js"; const c = new RenewalCalendar("2024-12-31"); console.log(c.advance(), c.advance(), c.advance());'

defects.why_missed: S9(a): constructing the calendar and advancing through a short month into another month requires three ordered operations; ordinary-day repetitions and isolated clamping checks stay green.

defects.description: Retry intervals grow linearly instead of doubling, scheduling later uncapped retries too early.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {RetrySchedule} from "./src/backoff.js"; const s = new RetrySchedule(10, 100); console.log(s.next(), s.next(), s.next());'

defects.why_missed: S9(a): the first two retry intervals agree with exponential backoff, and only the third next() call reveals the incorrect growth; early cap checks also pass.
